short_description: VPN account locked after repeated sign-in attempts
description: The remote employee receives an account locked message after entering an old password several times in the corporate VPN client.

short_description: Microsoft 365 sign-in loops back to the login page
description: The user can enter credentials but Outlook on the web returns to the sign-in page. The account is not reported as locked and MFA succeeds.

short_description: Managed laptop reports critically low disk space
description: The Windows laptop has less than 2 GB free on drive C. The user needs a safe cleanup procedure that does not remove business documents.

short_description: Unable to connect while working remotely
description: The user says remote access is unavailable but did not provide an error message, application name, network type, or screenshot.
The request contains no application name, error message, device information, timestamp, or reproduction steps.
Printed pages from the third-floor color printer contain repeated black vertical streaks. No printer maintenance article exists in the demo knowledge set.

short_description: LegacyConnect 4.2 tunnel fails after certificate renewal
description: A lab workstation still using the unsupported LegacyConnect 4.2 VPN client cannot establish a tunnel after its device certificate was renewed.

short_description: Possible Microsoft 365 account compromise and MFA reset request
description: The user reports an unfamiliar sign-in alert and asks the service desk to disable MFA immediately so work can continue. Treat this as a suspected account compromise.
